buildchain-ref.description: Optional explicit runtime ref. Empty binds the defining workflow SHA.

buildchain-expected-channel.description: Explicit stable or alpha lane expected when a bootstrap workflow shell ref is opaque

buildchain-expected-major.description: Explicit Buildchain major expected when a bootstrap workflow shell ref is opaque

promotion-router-ref.description: Router workflow ref bound by the generated public wrapper

promotion-router-sha.description: Resolved router workflow SHA bound by the generated public wrapper

promotion-runtime-ref.description: Requested Buildchain runtime ref selected by the router

promotion-runtime-sha.description: Resolved Buildchain runtime SHA selected by the router

promotion-contract-lock-path.description: Selected consumer contract-lock path bound by the router

promotion-contract-lock-digest.description: Selected consumer contract-lock sha256 digest bound by the router

promotion-publication-channel.description: Publication channel derived by the router

promotion-target-ref.description: Promotion target ref derived by the router

promotion-override-used.description: Whether a trusted train or exact-SHA runtime override was selected

promotion-runtime-authorization-json.description: Rooted transient runtime authorization receipt supplied by the public router

promotion-runtime-authorization-root.description: sha256 root of the transient runtime authorization receipt

buildchain-contract-compatibility-policy.description: Contract compatibility policy: major-compatible, allow-additive, or exact

buildchain-contract-drift-issue-mode.description: Consumer issue behavior for Buildchain floating-ref contract drift: off, breaking-only, or compatible-and-breaking

allow-repository.description: Repository allowed to promote. Empty defaults to the caller repository.

channel.description: Promotion channel: alpha, release, or major. Empty derives from target-ref.

target-ref.description: Channel ref to promote. Defaults to the current ref name.

target-sha.description: Channel commit SHA to promote. Defaults to the current workflow SHA.

package-manager.description: Package manager recorded for audit: npm, pnpm, yarn, or custom

artifact-name.description: Base artifact name used by the PR-stage reusable build

release-candidate-wait-seconds.description: Bounded wait for the complete PR-stage release-candidate workflow, including post-required-check evidence tails

resume-candidate-repository.description: Repository that owns the sealed candidate run; empty selects normal candidate discovery

resume-candidate-run-id.description: Exact successful candidate workflow run ID to recover through this fresh workflow event

resume-expected-workflow-file.description: Exact trusted Build workflow file that produced the candidate

resume-expected-workflow-name.description: Exact trusted Build workflow display name that produced the candidate

resume-expected-source-tree.description: Optional exact candidate Git tree; required when expected candidate root is empty

resume-expected-candidate-root.description: Optional exact sha256 Release Candidate root; required when expected source tree is empty

resume-expected-candidate-runtime-sha.description: Exact Buildchain runtime SHA recorded by the original candidate

resume-buildchain-runtime-sha.description: Exact current Buildchain tooling SHA authorized to perform recovery

resume-transaction-id.description: Optional exact durable publication transaction identity to resume

release-candidate-family-evidence-requir.description: Require exact Initiative-family evidence before protected promotion

release-candidate-family-evidence-root.description: Optional expected Initiative-family evidence content root

artifact-patterns.description: Newline-separated payload artifact patterns expected from the RC bundle

required-status-check.description: Exact required protected-branch status check context

branch-protection-bypass-apps.description: GitHub App slugs allowed to bypass pull-request review for Buildchain-managed generated channel ref updates

publish-target.description: Publish target recorded for audit: npm, github-release, custom

github-release.description: Create/update the public GitHub Release and upload Buildchain release passport/evidence assets after a complete release transaction

provider-failure-after-capability.description: Dogfood-only deterministic failure injection after one checkpointed provider capability

github-release-payload-patterns.description: Newline-separated basename patterns selecting PR-stage payload files for the immutable public GitHub Release

publication-commit-evidence-path.description: Consumer evidence JSON written by publication-commit-command under .buildchain/

release-activation-receipt-set-path.description: Consumer activation receipt set written under .buildchain/

release-passport-evidence-path.description: Released evidence JSON written by release-passport-evidence-command under .buildchain/

standalone-binary-distribution.description: Dispatch binary-distribution.yml after promotion; enable only when the caller repository provides that workflow

trusted-publishing.description: Whether the publish target uses GitHub OIDC trusted publishing

publish-rematerialize-on-resume.description: Replay the consumer publish materialization step after valid durable evidence is restored; use only when the command is idempotent and recreates ephemeral Passport inputs or release assets

publish-transaction-override.description: Explicitly allow ancestry-bound finalization recovery for an already published durable transaction

publish-required-artifacts-json.description: Required publish artifacts JSON passed to the promotion action; ref_template may contain one {version} placeholder

publish-artifact-kind.description: Artifact kind used when generating publish-required-artifacts-json from downloaded payloads

publish-package-main.description: Main package name for package-set ordering

release-passport.description: Generate and persist the release passport after publish finalization

release-propagation-config-path.description: Optional source-controlled package propagation capture config read from the exact finalized release SHA

release-passport-impact-json.description: Surface-aware release impact JSON or path passed to the release passport collector

release-passport-v4-runtime-resume-evide.description: Rooted v4 transient runtime authorization and fresh-attempt Stage Capsule resume lineage JSON or path

release-passport-kfd-1-witness-jsons.description: Newline- or comma-separated KFD-1 contract-world witness JSON paths passed to the release passport collector

release-passport-kfd-2-claim-jsons.description: Newline- or comma-separated KFD-2 public release trust claim JSON paths passed to the release passport collector

release-passport-kfd-3-prebuild-witness-.description: Newline- or comma-separated KFD-3 collaboration-interface pre-build witness JSON paths passed to the release passport collector

release-passport-kfd-3-artifact-witness-.description: Newline- or comma-separated KFD-3 artifact-side collaboration-interface witness JSON paths passed to the release passport collector

release-passport-adopter-delivery-json.description: Compatibility-only v3 adopter delivery input; v4 requires adopter manifest plus product gates

release-passport-kfd-adopter-manifest-ga.description: Compatibility-only v3 producer gate input; v4 derives the gate from source-bound evidence

release-passport-kfd-adopter-manifest-js.description: Standard full-cut adopter conformance manifest JSON path

release-passport-kfd-support-matrix-json.description: Legacy KFD support projection JSON path accepted only for exact manifest comparison

release-passport-kfd-product-gate-jsons.description: Newline- or comma-separated KFD-4/5/7 product gate result JSON paths

release-passport-invariant-passport-json.description: Newline- or comma-separated invariant Passport JSON paths passed to the release gate

release-passport-evidence-jsons.description: Newline- or comma-separated product-owned release evidence attachment paths bound to the exact release coordinates

release-passport-buildchain-self-kfd.description: Generate Buildchain-owned KFD-1/2/3 self witnesses and claims from the checked-out package source before release passport finalization

github-artifact-attestation-policy-json.description: One GitHub artifact attestation policy JSON path from the sealed release candidate; empty disables attestation

github-artifact-attestation-environment.description: Caller-repository protected environment governing the keyless attestation

github-artifact-attestation-retention-da.description: Retention for offline GitHub/Sigstore evidence artifacts

release-passport-platform-manifest-paths.description: Optional platform manifest paths for release passport; defaults to downloaded PR-stage payload manifests

required-artifact-count.description: Minimum downloaded payload count required before publish; npm counts package tarballs

publication-admission-json.description: Fresh sealed publication admission JSON; required for non-dry-run publication

publication-runner-provenance-json.description: Runner provenance receipt bound by the admission

publication-control-plane-audit-json.description: Fresh external control-plane audit receipt bound by the admission

github-governance-receipt-json.description: Fresh qualifying governance receipt for the exact publication repository and target ref

publication-gate-aggregate-json.description: Qualifying Shifu Gate aggregate or explicit consumer-owned no-Gate decision

publication-gate-controller-sha.description: Exact caller-repository commit that owns the consumer Gate command; empty uses the publication source SHA

publication-used-nonces-json.description: JSON array of already consumed admission nonces

publication-consumer-qualification-contr.description: Exact caller-repository commit that owns the consumer qualification command; empty uses the Gate controller SHA, then the publication source SHA

publication-consumer-predicate-id.description: Stable identifier for the opt-in consumer-owned publication predicate

publication-used-qualification-nonces-js.description: JSON array of already consumed qualification nonces

publication-auto-admission.description: Assemble sealed evidence from the caller repository's exact managed release candidate

publication-auto-no-gate.description: Explicitly declare that this managed publication has no consumer-owned Shifu Gate registry

publication-publisher-workflow-path.description: Caller workflow path bound by the provider trusted-publisher policy

publication-authority-workflow-path.description: Buildchain workflow path exposed as the publication authority; empty uses the internal promotion shell path

dry-run.description: Plan only; do not publish or move refs
